describe: make the light blink faster or slower
guide: The blink is ON_MILLISECONDS and OFF_MILLISECONDS at the top of the sketch. Smaller numbers blink faster. Change both numbers and nothing else.
report: The light is on for $on ms and off for $off ms now -- it was $old_on and $old_off.
ON_MILLISECONDS is $on and OFF_MILLISECONDS is $off now, from $old_on and $old_off.
It blinks $on ms on, $off ms off now (1000 ms is one second).
teach: delay() waits that many milliseconds, so the two numbers are how long the light stays on and off.
